children: Nifty 50 opened today’s session with a gap-down at 22,678 versus Tuesday’s close of 22,750. It slipped further after opening and is now hovering around 22,620, down 0.6 per cent.
The advance/decline ratio of Nifty 50 now stands at 15/35, showing a bearish bias. L&T (up 4.6 per cent) is the top gainer, followed by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise (up 2.4 per cent).

At the other end, Infosys and Tech Mahindra, down 4.6 per cent and 3.1 per cent respectively, are the top losers. This is followed by TCS and HCL Technologies, down 2.8 per cent each. Therefore, IT stocks have come under pressure today.
Among the sectors, Nifty Auto, up 0.6 per cent, tops the chart, whereas Nifty IT, down 3 per cent, is the biggest loser.
Broadly, the chart shows a bearish bias for Nifty 50 and Nifty futures.
Nifty (Nov) futures began today’s session lower at 22,690 versus yesterday’s close of 22,844. It is now trading at 22,650, down 0.9 per cent.
As the contract has now dropped below the support at 22,700, the bears are gaining more strength. We expect the November futures to drop further.
The nearest support levels for Nifty futures are 22,540 and 22,480. Subsequent support is at 22,360.
In case the contract recovers from the current level, it will face resistance at 22,700 and 22,750. So long as the barrier at 22,750 stays true, the intraday outlook will remain bearish.
But if Nifty futures breaks out of 22,750, it can extend the upswing to 22,900. Only a decisive breakout of 22,900 can turn the outlook positive.
Short Nifty (Nov) futures at 22,670 with a stop-loss at 22,725. Book profits at 22,540.

title: Nifty Prediction Today – October 28, 2026: Nifty futures: Slips below support, consider shorts
